meta.title: Middle East and Central Asia
meta.status: Reusable map data for the family hub (brookhouser/turtle-bay). This is not a game page. It is not linked from the science-game home page and it is not published.

projection.name: equirectangular
projection.formula: x = longitude * cos(36 degrees), y = latitude
projection.note: geometry.geojson is unprojected WGS84 longitude and latitude. map.svg and map-render.js draw with this projection. Flip y when making SVG, because SVG y grows downward.

groups.name: Arabian Peninsula
groups.blurb: Yemen, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, and Kuwait. They sit between the Red Sea and the Persian Gulf.

groups.name: Levant
groups.blurb: Jordan, Israel, Palestine, Lebanon, and Syria. These are the countries along the eastern Mediterranean.

groups.name: Caucasus
groups.blurb: Georgia, Armenia, and Azerbaijan. They are the mountainous countries between the Black Sea and the Caspian Sea.

groups.name: The -stans
groups.blurb: Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan. Stan means land, so Kazakhstan means land of the Kazakhs.

groups.name: Turkey, Iraq, and Iran
groups.blurb: Three large countries that connect the peninsula, the Levant, the Caucasus, and the -stans.

countries.name: Yemen
countries.hook: Southwest corner of the Arabian Peninsula. Saudi Arabia is north and Oman is east. The Red Sea is west and the Gulf of Aden is south. The island of Socotra, out in the Arabian Sea, is part of Yemen.

partNotes.socotra: Socotra is the Yemeni island in the Arabian Sea, east of the Horn of Africa.

countries.name: Oman
countries.hook: Southeast corner of Arabia, on the Arabian Sea and the Gulf of Oman. A separate piece called Musandam sits up by the Strait of Hormuz. Yemen, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates are the land neighbors.

partNotes.musandam: Musandam is the Omani piece on the Strait of Hormuz. It does not touch the rest of Oman.
partNotes.masirah: Masirah is the Omani island off the east coast.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.hook: The big country in the middle of the Arabian Peninsula. It touches Jordan, Iraq, Kuwait, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Oman, and Yemen.

countries.name: Qatar
countries.hook: A small thumb of land sticking into the Persian Gulf. Saudi Arabia is the only land neighbor. Zoom in so it is easy to tap. Bahrain is the island nearby, and Bahrain is not on this quiz.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.hook: On the Persian Gulf, east of Saudi Arabia and north of Oman. The long name is the United Arab Emirates. UAE is the short name. Qatar is nearby but does not share a land border.

countries.name: Kuwait
countries.hook: Small country at the top of the Persian Gulf, tucked between Iraq and Saudi Arabia. Zoom in.

countries.name: Jordan
countries.hook: East of Israel and the West Bank. Syria is north, Iraq is east, and Saudi Arabia is south. Jordan has a short coast on the Gulf of Aqaba, not on the Mediterranean.

countries.name: Israel
countries.hook: On the Mediterranean Sea, south of Lebanon and west of Jordan. Palestine on this quiz is the West Bank beside it and the Gaza Strip on the coast. Egypt is to the southwest.

countries.name: Palestine
aliases: west bank and the gaza strip
countries.partialHint: Palestine on this quiz is both parts: the West Bank and Gaza. Either part by itself is not the full answer.
countries.hook: On this quiz, Palestine means two places: the West Bank and the Gaza Strip. The West Bank is inland, between Israel and Jordan. Gaza is the small strip on the Mediterranean, beside Israel and Egypt. Both parts are the same answer.
countries.partsNote: Drawn as the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, both labeled Palestine. Natural Earth admin-0 lines. This is the quiz label, not a statement about sovereignty.

partNotes.west-bank: The West Bank is the inland part of Palestine on this map, between Israel and Jordan.
partNotes.gaza: Gaza is the small Mediterranean part of Palestine on this map. It touches Israel and Egypt.

countries.name: Lebanon
countries.hook: A small country on the Mediterranean, north of Israel and west of Syria. It is a thin strip, so zoom in.

countries.name: Syria
countries.hook: North of Jordan, Lebanon, and Israel, south of Turkey, and west of Iraq. Syria has a short coast on the Mediterranean.

countries.name: Iraq
countries.confusableHint: Iraq and Iran are next to each other, and the names are one letter apart. Iraq is the country to the west. Iran is the larger country to the east.
countries.hook: Between Syria and Iran, south of Turkey, and north of Saudi Arabia and Kuwait. Memory hook: Mesopotamia means the land between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers. Iraq is west of Iran.

countries.name: Iran
countries.confusableHint: Iraq and Iran are next to each other, and the names are one letter apart. Iran is the larger country to the east. Iraq is to the west.
countries.hook: The large country east of Iraq. The Caspian Sea is on the north. The Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman are on the south. Iran also touches Turkey, Armenia, Azerbaijan, and Turkmenistan. Afghanistan and Pakistan are to the east, and they are not on this quiz.

countries.name: Azerbaijan
countries.hook: On the west side of the Caspian Sea, in the Caucasus. Georgia is northwest, Armenia is west, Iran is south, and Russia is north. A separate piece, Nakhchivan, touches Armenia, Turkey, and Iran.

partNotes.nakhchivan: Nakhchivan is the Azerbaijani piece between Armenia, Turkey, and Iran. It does not touch the rest of Azerbaijan.

countries.name: Armenia
countries.hook: Small and landlocked in the Caucasus, south of Georgia. Turkey is west, Iran is south, and Azerbaijan is on the other sides. Zoom in.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.hook: The wide country between the Black Sea and the Mediterranean. It reaches from Greece and Bulgaria east to Georgia, Armenia, Iran, Iraq, and Syria. The piece west of the Bosporus is the European part of Turkey.

partNotes.european: The smaller piece west of the Bosporus is the European part of Turkey.

countries.name: Georgia
countries.hook: In the Caucasus, on the east side of the Black Sea. Russia is north, Turkey is southwest, and Armenia and Azerbaijan are south and southeast. This is the country of Georgia, not the U.S. state.

countries.name: Kyrgyzstan
countries.hook: A mountain -stan in the east, touching China. Kazakhstan is north, Uzbekistan is west, and Tajikistan is south. Kyrgyzstan has no seacoast.

countries.name: Turkmenistan
countries.hook: The -stan along the east side of the Caspian Sea, south of Kazakhstan and north of Iran. Afghanistan and Uzbekistan are the other land neighbors.

countries.name: Tajikistan
countries.hook: A mountain -stan in the southeast. Uzbekistan is west, Kyrgyzstan is north, China is east, and Afghanistan is south. Tajikistan does not touch Kazakhstan or the sea.

countries.name: Uzbekistan
countries.hook: The middle -stan. It touches all four of the other -stans on this quiz, plus Afghanistan. It has no seacoast, and it does not touch China.

countries.name: Kazakhstan
countries.hook: The giant -stan across the north. It touches the Caspian Sea and stretches east to China. Russia is the long northern neighbor. Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Turkmenistan are south. Kazakhstan does not touch Tajikistan.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.hook: Context only. Egypt is not on the quiz. The Sinai Peninsula sits beside Israel and Gaza.

countries.name: Eritrea
countries.hook: Context only. Across the Red Sea from Yemen. Not on the quiz.

countries.name: Djibouti
countries.hook: Context only. On the African side of the Bab el Mandeb strait, across from Yemen. Not on the quiz.

countries.name: Bahrain
countries.hook: Context only. An island in the Persian Gulf near Qatar. Bahrain is not on the quiz.

countries.name: Cyprus
countries.hook: Context only. The island west of Syria, in the Mediterranean. Not on the quiz. Natural Earth splits the island; the map draws those pieces as one grey island.

countries.name: Greece
countries.hook: Context only. West of Turkey. Not on the quiz.

countries.name: Bulgaria
countries.hook: Context only. Northwest of Turkey. Not on the quiz.

countries.name: Romania
countries.hook: Context only. North of Bulgaria, by the Black Sea. Not on the quiz.

countries.name: Ukraine
countries.hook: Context only. North of the Black Sea. Not on the quiz.

countries.name: Russia
countries.hook: Context only. North of Georgia, Azerbaijan, and Kazakhstan. Not on the quiz. Only the southern edge is drawn.

countries.name: China
countries.hook: Context only. East of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Tajikistan. Not on the quiz. Only the western edge is drawn.

countries.name: Afghanistan
countries.hook: Context only. Between Iran and the -stans. The name ends in -stan, but Afghanistan is not on this quiz.

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.hook: Context only. East of Iran and south of Afghanistan. Not on the quiz.

countries.name: India
countries.hook: Context only. A western sliver beside Pakistan. Not on the quiz.

countries.name: Ethiopia
countries.hook: Context only. South of Eritrea. Not on the quiz.
